tools.name: screenshot_url
tools.description: Render any public https URL in a real browser and return a full-page screenshot (PNG) plus an axe-core accessibility audit — WCAG violations with rule id, impact, a fix-it link, and affected-node counts. See what a page actually looks like and what is wrong with it, in one call. Free. https only.

tools.name: generate_qr
tools.description: Generate a QR code as an SVG for any text or URL. Free.

tools.name: generate_chart
tools.description: Render a simple chart as an SVG from a series of numeric values. Free.

tools.name: generate_og_image
tools.description: Generate a social / OpenGraph preview image (SVG) with a title and optional subtitle and theme. Free.

tools.name: validate_phone
tools.description: Validate a phone number: is it a well-formed E.164 number, and what country calling code and region does it carry? Pure format + country check, no network call, no message sent. Free. For the authoritative carrier and line type (mobile / landline / VoIP), use the paid phone-intel tool.

tools.name: list_premium_tools
tools.description: List MimirAPI premium pay-per-call tools available over x402 (USDC on Base) — wallet sanctions screening, ephemeral Postgres databases, and provenance certificates. No signup, no API key: each answers HTTP 402 with a payment challenge.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_premium_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List MimirAPI premium pay-per-call tools available over x402 (USDC on Base) — crypto/token price routing, wallet sanctions screening, ephemeral Postgres databases, and provenance certificates. No signup, no API key: each answers HTTP 402 with a payment challenge." → after: "List MimirAPI premium pay-per-call tools available over x402 (USDC on Base) — wallet sanctions screening, ephemeral Postgres databases, and provenance certificates. No signup, no API key: each answers HTTP 402 with a payment challenge."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
